releases.body:
Sync the npm package README with the English README.

- Move the Chinese README to docs/README.zh-CN.md
- Ensure npm selects the English README for the package page
- No runtime code changes

Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-ecosystem-manager`

Adds plugin update checks and upgrades, including the manager itself.

- /ecosystem updates checks installed npm package plugins against the registry
- /ecosystem upgrade [name...] upgrades one or all outdated plugins
- Dashboard gains upgrade status, per-plugin upgrade buttons, and upgrade-all
- Local/git/file plugins are reported but never auto-updated
- Manager self-update works when installed from npm; local builds show as local

Adds the awesome-opencode community catalog: 39 official + 122 community plugins (161 total), source filters, community badges, and 
pm run refresh:catalog.

releases.name: Ecosystem Manager v0.1.0
releases.body:
First public release of Ecosystem Manager for OpenCode V2.

- Browse 39 ecosystem plugins with V1/V2 compatibility and npm availability.
- Toggle individual plugins; only selected packages are installed or removed.
- `ecosystem_manager` tool and `/ecosystem` command.
- Local dashboard via `/ecosystem ui` with token-protected API.
- Uses `opencode plugin add/remove`, preserving JSONC comments and unrelated config.
- Auto-syncs managed plugins on load and after config reloads.

Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-ecosystem-manager`
